title: FizzBuzz
prompt: Write fizzbuzz(n) that returns a list for the numbers 1 to n. For each number: 'FizzBuzz' if it is divisible by 3 and by 5, 'Fizz' if only by 3, 'Buzz' if only by 5, otherwise the number as text, e.g. '7'.
hints: Take the numbers 1 to 15 and write down by hand what each should become. Which number is the trickiest?
A number divisible by both 3 and 5 also matches the 'only 3' test. Does the order of your checks matter?
Plan: loop i from 1 to n inclusive; check the 'both' case first, then 3, then 5, else the number as text; collect the results in a list and return it.

edge_hints.zero: n = 0 means no numbers at all, so the list is empty.
edge_hints.single: For n = 1 the list has one item and it is the text '1', not the number 1.
